name: Lonecat's ZIT NSFW 8.0.1
notes: Preferred StoryDriver workflow from a successful full Lonecat ZIT NSFW 8.0.1 ComfyUI history prompt. StoryDriver only replaces node 1342.positive, optionally replaces node 1317.negative, optionally sets node 1307.seed, and retrieves final saved output from node 1704. ComfyUI owns all model, LoRA, sampler, detailer, upscaler, size, and save settings. This is the full Lonecat graph, so expected time is higher than a minimal Z-Image Turbo or Flux/Klein graph; measured first-image time can land around 4 minutes on the current AMD runtime.
